name: albo
description: Recommendations from your taste, search across your Albo saves, private collections, and your Albo brain as a second brain.

interface.longDescription: Use your Albo taste history, ratings and dislikes to get recommendations that feel like you. Search saved films, shows, places and more, then create private collections you can browse in Albo. Build your taste record over time by saving finds and logging what you have watched or visited in Albo. Members of an Albo team also get the Albo brain: Markdown pages your AI checks before answering, remembers decisions into, tidies, and uses to follow your team's skills.
defaultPrompt: Based on the films I loved in Albo, what should I watch next?
Find the restaurants I saved for my next trip.
Create a private collection for these recommendations.
